message.content: During the community picnic planning discussions, RexxarRemar suggested incorporating music as a great touch to enhance the atmosphere and create a joyful vibe. He specifically recommended ensuring the music was not too loud so as not to disturb others nearby. Additionally, RexxarRemar suggested bringing blankets or chairs for seating, which he believed would make it more comfortable to relax and enjoy the food outdoors. His suggestions aimed to make the picnic both fun and enjoyable for everyone involved.
